avis.texte: Burned my skin and dysrupted the barrier and now my skin has been burning for months.
Wish this came in a squeeze tube. The dispenser is a waste and the formula consistency is too airy. Product itself goes on smooth and light. Murad really does no wrong.
completely broke out my skin and gave me considerably more acne scars. do not use this product if you have dry skin. it's genuinely so bad that only laser treatments can truly fix this.

avis.titre: This is a GODSEND for acne scars
avis.texte: I had some really gnarly blemishes on my eyebrow/chin/jawline that scarred so dark it was embarrassing going out without concealer on. My lovely coworker gave me her Invisiscar treatment and oh my gosh, what a difference! Was it an overnight fix? Of course not. I applied it twice a day for a couple weeks but then I really started to notice a big improvement in the appearance of my scars. I feel like my skin texture was much softer on the treated areas as well. The texture of the product is really nice and a little bit goes a LONG way, I have to be careful not to use a full pump or I end up wasting precious product. If you have very noticeable acne scars, this is the product for you!! I will absolutely buy this once my product runs out. My before/after pics are unfiltered and I have no makeup on in them (in the pic with my green glasses I do have fresh self-tanner on though but the acne marks look the same as without)

I really wanted this to work on my skin for 3 scars that wouldnt go away but instead i got some crazy breakouts in my face. I kept applying and it would burn my skin and now I actually have much MORE acne then i did before. Been using this for about 3 months.

avis.titre: it burns and makes my skin breakout
avis.texte: Im a week into using this product and my skin burns and my cheeks are breaking out.

I am about half way through the bottle and I would def recommend this. I can already see an improvement. I had an accident with a curling iron and it left a scar on my forehead. I've uploaded a before and current photo but can already see it improve

I chose to invest in trying this product simply because all the ingredients passed the clean skin app on my phone. No irritants or clogging products to indice acne. I will try it for a few months and update results.

I've been using this on and off for a few months, I enjoy it and using it for just a few days in a row seems to make a difference. It's a weird texture and feels a bit weird at first. However, it seems to leave an odd smell on my hands. Regardless of if I wash them after use, the next day they have a strong smell, almost like spray tan (which is so weird because the product smells nothing like that). Maybe it's a reaction with my skin, as I've seen no one else say this.

I have a few acne scars on my cheeks, I even did laser c02 a few months back to even them out and didn't seem to help much. Second day of using this product and it truly is making my skin even again 10/10!

I've been using this product for about 3 weeks and did notice shrinkage in some scars and pores after the first few uses. It feels like the product just sits on my top of my skin and doesn't really absorb. I feel like i need to use a lot for it to spread but it pills up on my hands so I'm not even sure if it's spreading evenly. I will finish the bottle but will not repurchase.
It burned my acne scars and ive only used it teice not i have a bigger scar than before

avis.titre: I would buy this product again & again
avis.texte: Coming from someone who has acne scars and dark spots (my biggest insecurities) this product does wonders. I haven't used for the full 8 weeks as it suggest but I know I will and I'm very happy with it.

I purchase this because I have a few age spots coming through because I lived in a tanning bed from age 16 to about 21. I don't have acne damage but these age or sunspots are in the worst possible places. Like I have one right outside of the corner of each of my eyes. It looks horrible. That's why I purchased this product. The first time I put it on I loved it. It went on so smoothly and made my skin feel like Silk. It felt so good that I thought I picked up the wrong item and it was some kind of excellent primer. It made my skin feel better than any product I've used in a very long time. As far as decreasing the color of those age spots, I have high hopes. I've used it for about a week. So far I'm really liking it. I hope it minimizes the color of these age spots a little bit so they're less noticeable. I love to wear just Tinted Moisturizer instead of foundation but I really can't do that anymore with these dark age or sunspots.
This causes a chemical burn on my face and now I'm hoping it doesn't scar!

I have gone through two rounds of this product and cannot say it completely removed my acne scar. For some odd reason I found that the trial size was more effective than the full size. I would not recommend this product at this price point
Woke up the next day with a rash on my face. Allergic to this product.
This took a few weeks to take effect but it really did work with pitting and redness. I stopped using it and there's definitely a difference, especially with redness
terrible product, had immediate burning sensation and left my skin and irritated

Product work d really well for me for about 2-3 weeks. After that I didn't notice much change in my skin and I have so many acne dark spots. They did get smaller but I haven't seen any disappear. I have major acne prone skin and this product is more for someone who has 4-6 dark spots and unfortunately I have way more than that.
This really works. I've been using this product for a year and my complexion looks so much smoother. Wish I had discovered this years ago. I never let myself run out of this!

avis.titre: This will ALWAYS be in my daily routine!
avis.texte: This product has been a complete game changer for me. I suffered from horrible acne as an adolescent and have consistently struggled with picking my skin, causing acne scars to be a recurring problem for me. I'd tried so many scar treatments to no avail, but once I tried this, my scars started fading within a few weeks. I have incredibly acne prone skin, but I personally have never had a breakout from using this product. I do have to agree with the reviewers who point out the fact that the texture is inconsistent and that it can tend to pill once you get to a certain point in the bottle, but in my experience, this hasn't affected the outcome of results at all. This is definitely one of my all time faves!
Don't even bother! I used this consistently for weeks on a newer dark spot and saw no results. Really waited it out but was not worth it, wish I had just returned

This is the second time I purchased the InviScar Resurfacing treatment. The first time it worked great. This time, within a week, it became very watered down and pretty much useless. I tried shaking it to see if it would distribute better, but nothing changed. So, pretty much waste of money.

I can't speak on results because when I put it on it pills up so bad, I don't see how it could possibly be doing anything in little balls sitting all over my face. I tried putting it on before and after moisturizer and still beads up. And it has a thick greasy feel that doesn't seem to absorb into skin. I love all Murad other products but I don't think I like this one.
First time using it made my skin burn a bit. Caused me to break out. Do not recommend

I'm so torn about this product. One the one hand my skin is looking great, on the other I never feel like I got what I paid for with it. The formula separates. The first 1/3 is very oily, the second 1/3 is dry and gritty which clogs the bottle. I don't think I even make it to the last 1/3 because it literally won't come out. If they could just get their suspension right this would be such a brilliant product. I thought I was doing something wrong until I saw all the other reviews. Murad, come on. This stuff is expensive, it could at least be consistent.

I've been using this product for a week and now I have chemical burns on my face!!! My skin is also peeling and really dry. I regret ever buying this product. I can only hope the chemical burn does not leave a scar!

Honestly this has been SUCH a game changer. I am a chronic skin picker and because of that have some very dark acne scars all across my forehead. After literally 2-3 uses I got comments from family who sees me regularly about how well they'd been fading. I literally have a picture of before and after and the difference is night and day. That being said-- it is harsh. It did break me out mildly BUT pair it with a heavy overnight cream (I use makeup revolution's overnight moisture cream or the ordinary's surface moisturizer) and honestly you'll be fine. Definitely repurchasing because I got the smaller size and had a lot of area to cover.

I have been using this product for past week and have been having horrible breakouts. After reading reviews I now know it's this because it's the only new thing I changed in my skin routine. Do not recommend. Money down the drain. Very upset.
I been using for two days and every time I wake up my skin looks worst. Where I applied the treatment it ended up being red and I tried washing my face but same thing. It's like it burnt my skin.

I really wanted to like this but it just feels greasy on the skin and doesn't ever absorb. I'll put it on and go to work and at the end of the day it's still feels greasy to touch. I haven't noticed any difference I'm trying to use it up since it was so expensive but I can't wait to get a new scar treatment.

When using this, I had slight burn and tingling feeling on my face and after days of use, it got me cystic acne on my chin, cheeks, face. It doesn't work for me. Had to let go and change my skincare, again.
I put it in overnight and woke up with darker patches. My skin looks awful now :( I'm so upset because it's so expensive.
This stuff smells awful and the scent stays with you all day. Not very impressed with the results either. Also, stings a little.

I have very old acne scarring from when I was a teen on my cheeks, relatively smooth skin everywhere else. used this just on those areas and woke up to peeling skin with breakouts and a mild chemical burn. 100% not worth it. Been seeing an esthetician and my results with her peels have been MUCH better.

I have multiple acne scars and have tried a lot of things to get rid of them. I decided to give this a try and have had amazing results in 2 weeks. My scars have not fully gone away but they have gotten lighter and are starting to fade away! Def recommended to us hydrating lotion because it did dry out my face a little.

I have one scar on my neck from a spider bite that never healed so I decided to try this after seeing a display in Ulta. Last night I swiped some on the scar but had quite a bit left on my finger so I sort of blended it on my chin and jawline where I have had breakouts before, just thinking it might smooth everything out. I woke up this morning with little white pimples all over the places I put this product. I can't say if it'll do what it's intended to do but it's definitely not worth the risk for me.

So I had a pimple that left a dark circle on my forehead. I brought this cream and I seen results the same week. It's not completely gone but it so faded that you can't even tell it was there. I've been using for two weeks and I use in am and night. I also add a moisturizer on top of it. Since it's been working I stated using on my chin. Which dried the skin out slightly. However I just a moisturizer and it's fine. I highly recommend this spot treatment.

avis.titre: Had High Hopes & Wanted to Love
avis.texte: I've been using this 2x/day & no results. It pills after I put it on. It's nice & thick so it glides on easy & makes your skin very soft. I'm in my 40s & have horrible brown spots on my jawline from ear to ear. Makeup doesn't even cover them & I've tried tons! I get acne & cystic acne each month ecactly 2 weeks before my period starts. When I'm out in the sun, I get very dark so my tone evens out a little. I've just accumulated so many scars over the years that nothing has helped. What works for one may not work for another so don't let this dissuade you from buying this product. I'm still going to try their other products because you never know!

avis.titre: Returned it, Not worth the cost
avis.texte: didn't see much improvement and then after 1.5 weeks the mixture would separate when it came out of the bottle. Oils and other mixture would separate

Although it's pricey this works ! I kept picking my acne and it left behind scars/ dark spots on my face. After using this for two weeks there is definitely a difference and they are lighter and smaller !

I got this as in a trial size. I don't have any scars on my face, but what I do have is sun damage. In particular, a really dark sunspot (like a large, dark freckle) under my eye that I've hated for years. Anyways, I e been applying it on this dark spot several times a day and I'm very pleased with the results. My dark spot is drying out and the layer underneath is less dark...which gives me hope that it will even6go away altogether. My sample size is .17 and has lasted me for weeks. I'm a huge sceptic of fancy products and is quick to say if a product isn't worth it, but this one has worked a miracle for me and is worth the cost.

When i first started using this it made my skin so much better. I had no breakouts and my acne scars were going away. However after using it for a couple weeks I ended up with a chemical burn. My skin was red, bleeding, and itched a lot. The next day my skin was completely dried out and started to peel. It's gotten better but is still peeling and still burns.

This is primarily dimethicone and as such the price point is not really acceptable. I use it on body scars, not my face. It has improved the appearance of a scar on my leg from a garden wire and a scar on my forearm from a bug bite (both over a year old). It has to be patted on because there is simply too much silicone for it to spread properly. I wouldn't purchase this unless the scar involves a pit/divot/uneven level on the skin. If you just want to fade spots there are better products to accomplish that.
I suffer from severe eczema on my face and NOTHING helped until this product! In less than a week my most aggressive spots are almost entirely flat and healing!
I really wanted to like this product but after a few uses my skin was irritated and had red marks where the product was applied. Not satisfied for that I paid.
Didn't do much. I switched and tried Cerave Retinol Serum and WOW. Now that works and it's half the cost!
This product has helped so much to fade out the redness and even out a lot of my pitted scars. Definitely worth trying for anyone with scars.

I guess for some people it works but for some it doesn't. For me it did nothing at all. It feels sort of greasy and didn't get rid of any of my scars or even lightened them. If your really interested in the product buy the smaller version first it doesn't work for everyone.
I'm using the 30 day kit my whole face is pealing I need to return this
Used this product for 2 months morning and evening and it didn't help with anything. It didn't help the pigment or fade the scars. For the price I was expecting GREAT RESULTS.

This product is awful. I have been using it for almost 2 months and my scars are still visible, no improvement in my skin at all. It is so dry when you put it on the skin and it burns!!!! Not worth the money at all.

I have cystic acne which has left me with tons of scarring. I got this product for Christmas and not even a month later 80% of my scars are gone. It hasn't broken me out or irritated my skin AT ALL and is well worth the price. I highly recommend this for new and old scarring because it is truly amazing.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again!!!
avis.texte: Love this product but something that I dislike my second & third bottle came with a lil product only last 2 weeks . It works i think is doing the work.
Bought this for my daughter and it has made a difference. She loves it

I feel like it's hard to leave a review on skincare product since everyone's skin is different. That being said, this has not worked for me. I've been using for well over 8 weeks and can tell no difference. I think the only thing it's succeeding in doing is causing me to breakout. It's disappointing because the stuff is expensive. For reference, I have ice pick scars mainly.

While I can't speak on the effectiveness of this product since I've only been using it for about a week, I will say that it sits horribly on my skin. Regardless of whether I use any other products with it, it pills up and leaves little balls ALL over my skin, plus it smells strange/unpleasant. It does have a smooth, velvety texture at first which I liked, but the way it sits on my skin afterward is just awful. I don't even know if I want to keep using it, it's that bad.
I always get hormonal acne around the time of my period, and this has been a great product that has helped it look like those scars never happened!
Defin Lightweight and breathable on the skin would recommend this to friends

I can't believe I get to Wright this review. So I tried out Murads InvisiScar Resurfacing Treatment and it completely got rid of every single old scar on my face from being young and picking my face. It left me with soft smooth skin. Helped get rid of not just my old acne scars, but also helped reduce the sunspots on my face. I love this product and will continue to use it. I highly recommend you purchase it!
I didn't see much change in my old acne scars but some difference was there after 2 weeks of use. It warms when rubbing in and is fragrance free!

I have a lot of shallow pitted scars and several deep ones that have made me very self conscious. Thought I'd give this a go and I am SO happy I did. It says 8 weeks- it took me about 2 wks to see results and today at around 4 wks I can not believe how much smoother my face looks. The deep ones are now as shallow as the small ones, I am so excited to see what the next month brings.

So I definitely have tons of acne scars. This product worked so well for my acne scars. I used it for weeks. I notice a huge difference in how light my scars have become. I've also noticed they look a lot smaller and less defined. I am so happy I was able to try this out because I was so self conscious about my acne scars until now. If you have acne scars I would totally recommend you try this product out.
I get redness and acne around that time of the month and this helped heal my acne scars from the deep zits I get sometimes. I'm really impressed!
I was super disappointed in this product after reading all the amazing reviews. I have oily skin with acne scarring. This did nothing at all.

While I liked the way this product made my skin look (so perhaps the resurfacing part), I'm unsure of whether it helps with scarring. I didn't have anything too major on my face, so it was sort of an "eh" product for me.

I used to have acne-prone oily skin, but after switching to the murad H2O-based glorifying gel my acne, eczema, and little white irritation spots went away! With the gel plus InvisiScar Resurfacing treatment combination, my complexion has completely cleared out and my skin tone has evened out. My friends even noticed how perfect my face is now and ask for recs!! I use the resurfacing treatment a few times a week nightly and pat it on my acne scar-prone areas and you do not need a lot of product. I haven't been able to step outside without makeup in years and now i can walk the streets naturally beautiful without makeup 🥺 blessed for this treatment plus clarifying gel!

I was so excited to try this product!! I have lots of dark marks and scars on my shoulders and lower cheeks from acne and picking. I definitely loved the texture of this. It was like a paste that really worked into your skin. I would say that I noticed subtle results overtime, but I feel like this a product you would need to use a couple times and consistently to see big results. Still will probably repurchase!
I've tried resurfacing treatments before and this one by Murad really stand out! I saw an immediate difference in my skins texture and have been loving the results I'm getting.

I like the feeling of this product, but did not see much difference in the past weeks. I will have to keep using it more. But seeing as the moisturizer was a positive experience, I expect the same with this one.
This has truly helped me with some of my acne scars. Would 100% recommend to my Skincare Fanatic Friends

avis.titre: Be careful if you wear glasses
avis.texte: I've been using this for about five weeks and a week in I noticed I had small white dots on the bridge of my nose where my glasses sit. I followed the directions (use AM and PM) and realized that my glasses sitting on top of the treatment not allowing the skin to breathe was giving me a chemical burn. The white dots turned into postules and my skin peeled pretty badly. I stopped applying it on my nose altogether but applied everywhere else on my face. Overall it goes on creamy and blurs imperfections but leaves my face looking oily throughout the day. I can't apply anything on top of it because it just doesn't layer properly. No noticeable improvement so far.

Okay we got a late start but we did it. Im glad we did because her face looks so much better nice n smooth. When she started the treatment she got frustrated because she broke out so bad she refused to take a picture of herself. She kept using the product and as time went on she started seeing results and was very happy with the progress she saw in the mirror. She still has to keep using the Murad so she can be 100% clear. We recommend this product most definitely
This product was amazing. It worked incredibly well for my skin. I have recommended it to many of my friends.

There must be magic in this bottle! My face suffers from acne, which unfortunately leads to scars from left over from them. I used this stuff religiously, and I DID notice a difference. My cheek and cheekbones are problem areas, but the look of them are becoming lighter or maybe fading, either way it's working. Give it a try.

I used to deal with acne, so I have some scars and blemishes on my face. This treatment has done wonders for my skin. Since using it my blemishes are almost not existent. My face looks so smooth and blemish free. I use it every morning and night after washing my face and pair it with the Murad oil-free moisturizer gel.

I really like that it's lightweight and it doesn't have break out effect in me plus the scent is good. It's soft, well hydrated and very gentle to my skin. This has been my favorite product because it has no parabens, no sulfates and phthalates.
I have deep acne scars and pits on my face from picking and, well.. acne. Nothing I have used has helped minimize them until this! My face looks smoother, and the scars have faded dramatically.
This made my face look a lot better. It feels really good on my skin, and it made my pores look smaller.
I love the way my skin feels after using this product it smells clean and is an all in all amazing product

I honestly am extremely surprised at how amazing this product truly is with combating acne! I'm not sure if it'll help with deep acne scars, but I can attest that this has helped speed up the healing process. I normally use this once every other day - I shower and then as soon as I'm headed to sleep I apply this product and the next morning my pimple is barley even there or GONE!

The texture and smoothing effect reminds me a lot of a silicone based primer. When it comes to long term use to help minimize scars I really only noticed a difference in more recent scars like a few acne scars I had after particularly bad breakouts. While it did help fill in and minimize older scars short term there was no noticeable difference in the scar itself. I have not noticed any skin irritation after an extended period of use. All in all I would recommend this as a type of smoothing primer that helps heal small new scars sooner and dimish them than they would by themselves.
I have been using this on breakouts after they subside. have noticed minimal changes, I cant admit if it was due to the product or just my face overtime.

I used this product to treat some remaining acne scars on my forehead and chin. It really dried out any remaining lingering breakouts quickly and efficiently, while diminishing the look of skin color imperfections within just a tiny amount of product. I loved it!

This is the best at making all my pores disappear! Love the matte texture of this product as it goes on and makes a great base to put on makeup. It feels just like a primer on my skin as it seems to smooth out all the pores and provides a great base for foundation or powder. Also, love the experience of dispensing and using this product as it's so chic and different looking. Love how it looks and love how it makes my skin look

I've definitely seen a difference in my scars' appearance! I have scarring from acne and rosacea and this really helped to blur them. My only complaint is that it pills on the skin and you can't pair it with moisturizers or niacinamide.
Goes on like a primer, instantly leaves trouble spots looking smoother while actually helping to fade acne scars and the texture they leave behind. Nice under makeup.

This stuff works so well. I have tried a few different scar products and non had performed as well as the Murad one. I highly recommend this! The skin absorbed the formula and left the skin more clear and smooth.
It made my few scars lighter. Which is an improvement from dark spots on my face.
I have lots of acne scars from years ago and new. This has significantly Diminished the sight of them.

My skin has issues during the warmer months as I tend to be a lot more oily when the warm weather hits. That being said, I always have breakouts on my forehead, my nose as well as my chin. I have tried so many products to stop acne, but also to clear my skin up from my previous acne breakouts. I have had scarring due to the breakouts and this product has helped clear up my skin, as well as has helped the texture of my skin be a lot more smooth. That makes me so happy because my confidence rises when I have great looking skin and I have received many compliments from family who have noticed the results. My skin looks and feels less bumpy and scarred up, and I've noticed some spots have completely went away. I highly recommend this product if you are looking to help your skin feel better and look better. My acne is no more and I can say that with continuing to use this treatment, I know how much more my face will clear up. I absolutely love the results already and have not had this great of results with other high price products that I have tried. I am in love and will recommend this to all my friends to use.

Honestly, I think vitamin C is overrated. I hate vitamin c serum with those glass bottle dropper thingy. It's always oxidized before i finish the bottle. Love the pump packaging. The texture is not like anything I've seen before kinda like quicksand. Did a wonderful job fading hyperpigmentation. I wouldn't buy this again just because I don't like the fragrance and vitamin c. I usually opt for something more stable and gentler than this for hyperpigmentation.

avis.titre: Be patient and consistent - this really works!
avis.texte: I started using this product a few months ago and have been impressed! Obviously there is no miracle product that will make your acne scars disappear, but this is pretty dang close. Noticeable reduction in redness, discoloration, and bumps. Only complaint is the pump bottle is hard to get everything out - I feel like a lot of product is wasted. I unscrew and use a q-tip to get it all out.

I have scarring/ dips on both of my cheeks; let's blame it on high school puberty. I put a thin layer prior to applying my moisturizer. There's a slight difference in the appearance of my scarring but not a huge change. It definitely worked on my smaller dark, acne spots. Overall, if you use this habitually, the results will make a big difference.

This is so easy to use and I really feel like it is helping to reduce the small amount of scarring I have from blemishes! In the short time I've been applying it, they appear to be fading and I'm excited to see how much more they'll improve!

I was SHOCKED by how well this treatment worked for my skin. I have dry skin, but it is also super acne prone in my cheek area. I find this to be a super unique problem, because mostly acne products are made for oily skin types, and hence a lot don't work on me. To top it off, I'm South Asian and suffer from hyperpigmentation and dark spots left by acne. This treatment had a difference in just a few days of using (unusual for products like these on the market that usually take upto 2-3 weeks to start showing results)! It absorbed really nicely into my skin and went on super smooth. It is a little bit on the pricier side, but well worth it - in my opinion. I love that it comes with a pump - that makes it really easy to not get any bacteria into the product itself. 10/10 would recommend this for people who suffer from acne and dark spots/hyperpigmentation.

this product helped smooth out my acne scars so much! it helped fill them in but also didn't leave a tacky feeling after. it also had a present scent and was a thick feeling material. would buy again!!
Still waiting to see dramatic effects but I haven't been using it very faithfully. Good product overall!

This treatment was really good! Be careful to not pop any pimples and try using this. It will sting. I had a breakout and used this along with the water gel and my acne went down during the night. I did not even use my usual on-spot treatment which usually does the same. I really like it and my blemishes have gotten lighter. This is something I see myself using and always buying.

I felt like Murad's InvisiScar Resurfacing treatment had this slightly warming effect on my skin when it touched it which immediately changed my mind bc I mean, heat, peel, 🤷🏻‍♀️ Either way I've been using this for about two weeks and feel like one of my imperfections seems to be looking better so with more help from Murad I'm hoping to finally feel good about myself

The InvisiScar Resurfacing Treatment is really amazing at what it does. Along with scars I have from acne it also got rid of scars I had from picking at ingrown hairs. My biggesy issue is the slight smell it has is a little offputting for me
This scar treatment has finally helped smooth out my skin!! I am so happy with this product I will be using all over for all of my small scars!

I have a pale complexion and every little blemish and even dry patches leave marks on my skin. I only get an occasional breakout or blemish during my period but they always mark, no matter how tiny. This did not really help with those mild purplish dark marks, so I can't believe it would do a lot for someone who actually has acne. It did brighten up my overall complexion but that's not really what I was using this for.

This stuff is a lifesaver! I've been using for several months and it has worked miracles. I had deep, pitted acne scars and scar every time I have a pimple (and I usually only break out during ~that time of the month~) I use this every night, and its amazing. It feels like a makeup primer. This has lightened my scars and evened my skin. It has helped increase my confidence so much.

The product is okay. I did not see that many results after using it for several weeks. The consistency left on the skin is also a little oily. However, overall it's a good product that I would recommend.

This treatment applies with a feel like a makeup primer. It is a little thick and has a scent that wasn't my favorite but it goes away in a couple minutes. I didn't notice any great changes when using this and I actually felt a slight burning sensation when I put it on. It didn't leave any lasting irritation or cause any breakouts.
This product does exactly what it says for sure I will be having this for now on

So I've been struggling with cystic acne on my back/chest/shoulders along with breakouts on my face. These breakouts always scar. It doesn't matter if i pick at them or not, whitehead volcano or not...there's always a scar left behind. No other treatment has ever worked in the past (antibiotics, topicals, prescription soaps, switching laundry detergents, changed diet, salicylic acid washes don't even help with my chest/back/shoulder area). SO now i'm taking Myorisan. Now that my acne is slowly starting to clear up, i have more scars and they're not pretty. I asked a worker at Ulta which acne scar treatment he recommends and he took me straight to the Murad stuff. Him and I weren't sure if it was going to be too much while on Myorisan but so far I haven't had any problems. I've been using it twice a day for the last 5 days and I already see a huge difference, some of the scars actually disappeared after 3 days of treating them. And an added bonus, it has a nice smell and it's not overwhelming.

Just to clarify, there is no way an over the counter product can get rid of TRUE acne scars like ice pick or rolling.
